snippet.title: Bound Crystal Saga - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Official reveal trailer for Bound Crystal Saga, an Action RPG where you control one of four unique heroes, each with distinct abilities and personalities. The game will feature a day and night cycle, as well as a weather system that influences events and even the heroes' powers.
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4389560/Bound_Crystal_Saga/
